high_priority_issues.description: complex-pow returns 0 for 0^w when Im(w) != 0, which is an essential singularity and should be undefined
sparse-coo-add uses dense O(N^2) accumulator, defeating purpose of sparse storage for large matrices
sparse-csr-mul uses dense O(N^2) accumulator, making sparse matrix multiplication infeasible for large matrices
Mixing AD values from different tapes causes silent incorrect gradients - no tape consistency check
QR deflation logic is flawed - continues full O(N^3) QR on entire matrix even when sub-matrices converged
normalize-signal causes division by zero on empty vectors
Uses identity function instead of matrix-identity - will crash when trying to scale an integer as a matrix
S-expression parser regex truncates at first closing paren, breaking nested structures
Relies on external 'claude' CLI in PATH - fragile dependency for daemon environments
(cdr (assq 'body post)) crashes if post missing 'body' field - partially patched but still vulnerable via forum/tools.ss
vec-append/vec-set creates full copies during construction - O(N^2) makes implementation unusable for non-trivial patterns
PCG PRNG used for 'Crypto Placeholders' but is not cryptographically secure
Unsafe 'read' in string->gen can lead to arbitrary code execution on untrusted input
O(N^2) parsing due to substring copying on every character consumption
O(N^2) list shuffling due to list-ref/list-set in loop
O(N^2) whitespace trimming in INI parser due to repeated reverse calls
fsm-complement incorrect for incomplete DFAs - missing dead-state transitions cause both language and complement to reject same strings
reader-local environment leak - modified environment persists to all subsequent operations instead of scoped sub-computation
many-till infinite loop if body parser succeeds without consuming input - lacks progress check
reader-local leak bug duplicated in combined handler run-reader-in-writer

false_positive_patterns: Hallucinated missing error handling that was present (e.g., d-pow negative exponents)
Claims about outdated code that was already fixed (e.g., stderr leakage, JSON escaping)
recommendations: HIGH PRIORITY: Fix sparse matrix dense-accumulator bugs in core/linalg/sparse.ss
HIGH PRIORITY: Add progress checking to many-till parser combinator
HIGH PRIORITY: Fix reader-local environment leak in effects.ss
HIGH PRIORITY: Replace O(N^2) Aho-Corasick construction with mutable vector
HIGH PRIORITY: Add cryptographically secure PRNG option for security-sensitive operations
MEDIUM: Implement tape consistency checks in reverse-diff.ss
MEDIUM: Add bounds validation to sparse matrix constructors
LOW: Update stale file path headers across core/ modules
